title: analyze_impact input
description: Potential impact of changing symbols or files: everything that reaches them along resolved relationships, breadth first and bounded by depth, with totals by depth, project, area, and owning team. Not a safety proof: unresolved calls could also reach them. With imports among the types, files are walked file to file, each reported once at its shortest depth with the site of the import that reached it.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

oneOf.description: A symbol by name and file, in place of its id.

name.description: The name a lean row shows (BudgetLedger.consume), or the plain name (consume); it must name one symbol in the file.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the file that declares the symbol.

items.description: Or { name, path }: the symbol of that name in that file; an ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.

subject_ids.description: An external symbol id (ext_) starts from the code that calls it. A file_ id, or the id of a file's module symbol, starts from the file.

paths.description: Files to start from. A file by its repository-relative path, meaning the file itself and its module symbol; .., an absolute path inside the repository and backslashes are normalised. A path the snapshot does not index is INVALID_ARGUMENT naming its disposition. Give subject_ids, paths, or both.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: lean, the default over MCP: plain text with no JSON and no structuredContent. A header `# <tool> · <n> rows · <snapshot> current` (stale when the snapshot is older than the repository's current one), one `<name> <path>:<line>` row per result, then `# ` lines for the limitations of this answer and `# more: cursor <c>` when a next page exists. The line is the call, import or reference site for relationship, impact and path rows and the declaration for symbol rows; tags follow: in or out when both directions are asked, depth=<n>, dispatch, external, candidate, ambiguous, unresolved:<reason>, and the relationship type when the query mixes types. A name or path with a space, quote or # is quoted as JSON. compact: the JSON envelope without the snapshot-wide parts an earlier answer gave (coverage, unresolved reasons, standing limitations). full: the whole JSON envelope. Ask for compact or full for ids, evidence and totals.
